svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Renderer: the passes of a lit frame
Rows in the order compile() ran them (one frame with every optional pass, occlusion culling on, render.prepass off); columns are what each pass writes and reads.
render LOD and culling, first phase: what was visible last frame (compute)
occlusion, second phase: what the pyramid newly shows
readback, shading, debug view and post
on the backbuffer: debug lines, then the extensions' overlays
records its own barriers: geometry pool, tables, textures
occlusion's second phase: left out while occlusion or culling is off, and GeometryPass draws everything once

The graph orders passes by these accesses (Kahn sort) and inserts every barrier. Blit reads sceneColorAA, or debugview.color in a debug view; DebugViewResolve reads sceneColor in the streaming view only.

With render.prepass on, the phases run depth-only before shading: DepthPrepass, HzbBuild, the late culling passes, DepthPrepassLate and HzbBuildFinal, then one GeometryPass draws both phases behind an Equal test.

With a culling camera apart from the rendered one, DepthPrepassCull and DepthPrepassCullLate draw both phases from it into depth.cull, which HzbBuild and HzbBuildFinal read; GeometryPass then draws both phases with its own depth test.

Not drawn: cullParams and cullGroupBounds (written by the CPU, read by every culling pass), cullPlanes, lodResidency, lodGroupCounters and the staging buffers. Picking copies a texel of gbuffer.instance after the pass that writes it last (GeometryPassLate here).
